bio: Hi there, Class of 2029! My name is Julie, and I grew up in Northern Virginia. I graduated from Harvard College in 2018 with a concentration in the Comparative Study of Religion and a secondary in Math Sciences. After that, I spent a year at Dumbarton Oaks before completing a master's at the Harvard Divinity School in 2021, focusing on medieval Christian literature. Now, I'm an admissions and financial aid officer for the College and am thrilled to be a proctor too! I can't wait to meet you all, and welcome to Harvard!
